finding: The strict derivative-consistent AHL concept generalizes to source-authoritative bi-modal MvG Richards behaviour, but model-3 conductivity requires materially tighter and denser representation than retention/capacity to satisfy the same strict bottom-flux fidelity gate.
scientific_implication: Representation complexity is family- and observable-dependent. The state/derivative invariant generalizes cleanly, whereas conductivity support density is not transferable from unimodal MvG.
next_action: F-AHL25G paired complete-Richards performance characterization before any claim that model-3 AHL is computationally beneficial.
